3. Transport Layer: This layer is responsible for establishing a reliable connection between two devices and ensuring that data is delivered in the correct order. Examples of protocols at this layer include Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) and User Datagram Protocol (UDP).

4. Application Layer: This layer is responsible for providing applications and services to the user. Examples of protocols at this layer include Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP), File Transfer Protocol (FTP), and Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP).
